beats.html:
Disney would not put
its name on
The Nightmare Before Christmas.

They thought it was
too dark and too strange
for the Disney label.

It is now the thing
they sell you
every single October.

Somebody you know is
hiding the strange one.
That is usually the good one.

beats.html:
A mare was a spirit
believed to sit
on a sleeper's chest.

The weight. The paralysis.
The certainty something
is in the room.

People had a word for it
centuries before
they had an explanation.

Somebody you know has
woken up unable to move.
It has always had a name.
